The table above gives values of a function $h$ on the set $T=\{-4,-2,0,3,5\}.$ Compute the following:

${max}_{t\in T}h(t)=$
{{field-1}}

$\operatorname{arg}⁡{max}_{t\in T}h(t)=$
{{field-2}}

${min}_{t\in T}h(t)=$
{{field-3}}

$\operatorname{arg}⁡{min}_{t\in T}h(t)=$
{{field-4}}
question.worked_solution:
Recall that 

- ${max}_{x\in S}f(x)$ is the maximum output value, while

- $\operatorname{arg}⁡{max}_{x\in S}f(x)$ is an input in $S$ where that maximum output occurs.

On the other hand,

- ${min}_{x\in S}f(x)$ is the minimum output value, while

- $\operatorname{arg}⁡{min}_{x\in S}f(x)$ is an input in $S$ where that minimum output occurs.

The output values are $5,-1,-3,2,$ and $4.$ The maximum output is $5$ (at $t=-4$), and the minimum output is $-3$ (at $t=0$). 

Therefore, we have the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}{max}_{t\in T}h(t) & =5 \\ \operatorname{arg}⁡{max}_{t\in T}h(t) & =-4 \\ {min}_{t\in T}h(t) & =-3 \\ \operatorname{arg}⁡{min}_{t\in T}h(t) & =0\end{aligned}
$$
